DATABASE:         IST-Lisbon
DESCRIPTION:      S Baghel, L Marques and L L Alves, ''Cross-sections for H2 and NH3 relevant to N2-H2 plasma modelling” 2026 Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. (submitted). 
NH3-rot is a set of rotational excitation cross sections by electron impact, for transitions NH3(X,v=0,J=0) --> H2(X,v=0,J’) (J’=1-5), which complements the COMPLETE set of NH3 cross sections, available in this database under group NH3.
Calculations using these cross sections should include inelastic-stepwise and superelastic transitions between rotational states NH3(J=0) and NH3(J=1-5), considering Boltzmann distributions for the populations of the system: n_J/N = (g_J/P_(rot)) exp(-E_J/k_B T_g) with P_(rot) = Sum_J g_J exp(-E_J/k_B T_g). At T_g=300K, these populations are n_0/N=1.0783E-01, n_1/N=1.4703E-01, n_2/N=2.0251E-01, n_3/N=2.1306E-01, n_4/N=1.8724E-01, n_5/N=1.4233E-01.
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
